explanation: Pick the tennis ball (falling back to the moved object) and place it into the white tub container, skipping if already inside.
author: wonder
diff_from_parent:
--- v0.py
+++ v1.py
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+def run(scene, robot):
+    balls = scene.of_kind("tennis ball")
+    if balls:
+        ball = balls[0]
+    else:
+        ball = scene.with_role("moved")[0]
+    tub = scene.containers()[0]
+    for c in scene.containers():
+        if "tub" in c.kind.lower() or "white tub" in c.name.lower():
+            tub = c
+            break
+    if scene.is_inside(ball, tub):
+        return
+    robot.pick(ball)
+    robot.place_in(tub)
